New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

input.text: Hey @dave — I don't have a way to look up account ownership from here. Best bet is to check the Globex account record directly in the CRM, or I can ping someone who might know if you point me to them.

content.text: I replied to Dave letting him know I don't have access to look up account ownership data. I didn't want to guess or make up an answer — if you'd like, you can wire me up to a connector or tool that can query the CRM, and then I'd be able to answer these directly.
